# ANTONIOMDM OS

> Portfolio de Antonio Manuel Díaz Moreno, arquitecto de software e ingeniero sénior .NET.

Español por defecto; inglés en /en/. El escritorio interactivo y las rutas HTML comparten datos.

- [Perfil](https://antoniomdm.dev/about/)
- [Proyectos](https://antoniomdm.dev/projects/)
- [Platform 9¾](https://antoniomdm.dev/projects/platform934/): laboratorio multiplataforma con Flutter, webOS, Kotlin, Media3 y Jellyfin. API y agente con herramientas en desarrollo.
- [Experiencia](https://antoniomdm.dev/experience/): Domingo Alonso Group, julio 2021–actualidad; Anexia, Vector ITC, Nokia, Alcatel-Lucent y primeros trabajos.
- [Notas](https://antoniomdm.dev/notes/)
- [RSS](https://antoniomdm.dev/rss.xml)
- [CV](https://antoniomdm.dev/cv.txt)
- [Laboratorio](https://antoniomdm.dev/lab/): vistas previas de conceptos.
- [Arcade](https://antoniomdm.dev/arcade/): vista previa inicial, no un juego completo.

Trayectoria revisada el 10 de septiembre de 2026. Estudios completados salvo el proyecto final; título no obtenido. Liderazgo técnico no implica gestión formal de personal. La reducción de pruebas de aproximadamente una hora a dos minutos es una métrica aproximada.

## English

Portfolio of Antonio Manuel Díaz Moreno, Software Architect and Senior .NET Engineer. Spanish is the default; English routes live under /en/. The interactive desktop and static HTML routes share data.

- [Profile](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/about/)
- [Projects](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/)
- [Platform 9¾](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/projects/platform934/): multiplatform laboratory with Flutter, webOS, Kotlin, Media3 and Jellyfin. API and tool-using agent in progress.
- [Experience](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/experience/): Domingo Alonso Group, July 2021–present; Anexia, Vector ITC, Nokia, Alcatel-Lucent and early career.
- [Notes](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/notes/)
- [RSS](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/rss.xml)
- [CV](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/cv.txt)
- [Lab](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/lab/): concept previews.
- [Arcade](https://antoniomdm.dev/en/arcade/): foundation preview, not a complete game.

Career reviewed on 10 September 2026. Coursework completed except the final project; degree not awarded. Technical leadership does not imply formal people management. The integration-test reduction from about one hour to two minutes is approximate.
